headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 3, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 22.42% compared to SPY's 11.81%. This results in an average alpha of 10.60%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in value but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a notable return of 44.65%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', still shows a positive return of 16.09%, demonstrating resilience in a challenging market environment. Outperforming a broad benchmark like SPY is particularly relevant during periods of market stress, as it signals relative strength and effective management of portfolio assets. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
